goal: Turns on Boost.MultiIndex's invariant-checking debug mode in two CI jobs to catch data-structure corruption bugs in code that uses multi_index containers.
Left off the MSAN fuzz job because it would push that job past its runtime limit.

result.summary: This PR enables Boost.MultiIndex's invariant-checking debug mode (BOOST_MULTI_INDEX_ENABLE_INVARIANT_CHECKING) alongside the existing safe-mode flag in two CI jobs (i686-no-ipc and native-previous-releases). It deliberately excludes the MSAN fuzz job because enabling invariant checking there would exceed the CI runner's time limit, as verified by both the author and a reviewer who independently timed the run.
result.problem: Without invariant checking, subtle corruption or invariant violations in code using Boost.MultiIndex containers can go undetected in CI, only surfacing as harder-to-diagnose bugs later. This affects contributors relying on CI to catch such issues before merge.

fanquake's concern about the MSAN fuzz job timing out with invariant checking enabled, addressed by author's and jeanpablojp's local timing tests confirming ~210 min runtime, leaving it near the limit and excluded from the change.
jeanpablojp's confusion about the timeout value (180 vs 240 minutes), resolved when author pointed to the actual workflow run showing 240 minutes is correct.

categories.name: build
categories.evidence: The change is entirely within ci/test/*.sh setup scripts that configure build flags for CI jobs, matching the build category's CI configuration scope.
categories.rationale: P3 because this strengthens CI's ability to catch multi_index invariant violations, a stability improvement for contributors, but it is a narrow addition to debug-mode checking in only two of several CI jobs with no reported bug it currently catches. The author explicitly weighed and avoided extending it to the MSAN fuzz job due to runtime cost, showing the change is carefully scoped rather than broadly impactful.

uncertainties: No evidence yet that invariant checking has actually caught a real bug; its value is preventive rather than demonstrated by an incident.
result.card: This PR enables Boost.MultiIndex's invariant-checking debug mode in two CI jobs (i686-no-ipc, native-previous-releases) alongside the existing safe-mode flag, aiming to catch multi_index container invariant violations during testing. It is deliberately not enabled in the MSAN fuzz job because doing so would push that job's runtime close to or past its CI timeout, a claim independently verified by both the author (214 min) and reviewer jeanpablojp (208 min). The PR received an Approach ACK from jeanpablojp with confirming timing data, and a minor confusion about the exact timeout value was resolved when the author linked to an actual CI run. The change is small, mechanical, and CI-only, improving debug-time detection of a class of bugs without demonstrated prior incidents. No dependencies or blockers; reviewable now.
